svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SPI timing
svg.desc: SPI timing of the AT25040B in mode 0: CS low frames the transfer, SI is read on each rising SCK edge and SO changes after each falling edge, most significant bit first, with the Table 4-3 times for a 1.8 V to 5.5 V supply.
svg.text: SPI mode 0 (CPOL 0, CPHA 0). Datasheet: 4.3 AC Characteristics, Table
4-3, p. 5; 4.3 AC Characteristics, Table 4-3 (continued), p. 6; 5 Serial
Interface Description, p. 6; Features; Description, p. 1.
SCK clock frequency at VCC 1.8 V to 5.5 V
SCK clock frequency at VCC 2.5 V to 5.5 V
SCK clock frequency at VCC 4.5 V to 5.5 V
CS setup time (100 ns from 2.5 V)
CS hold time (100 ns from 2.5 V)
CS high time between transfers (100 ns from 2.5 V)
SCK high time (40 ns from 2.5 V, 20 ns from 4.5 V)
SCK low time (40 ns from 2.5 V, 20 ns from 4.5 V)
Data in setup time (40 ns from 2.5 V, 20 ns from 4.5 V)
Data in hold time (40 ns from 2.5 V, 20 ns from 4.5 V)
Output valid after the falling SCK edge (40 ns from 2.5 V, 20 ns from 4.5 V)
Output disable time after CS rises (50 ns from 2.5 V, 25 ns from 4.5 V)
Values for the whole 1.8 V to 5.5 V range, which the driver uses by
